0022600005.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Warriors visit the Lakers. Golden State is missing Brandin Podziemski (back, soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton (calf). In 2025-26 the Warriors lost 1-3 to the Lakers, including a 119-103 loss in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
